name: Municipal Corporation Sonipat
headquarters: Municipal Corporation, Railway Road, opposite PWD Rest House, Sonipat, Haryana
description: Civic archive for Municipal Corporation Sonipat, a Haryana NCR corporation constituted in 2015. The 2020 election covered 20 wards; the 2026 election covered 22. The KMP Expressway connects the Sonipat area with Manesar, and the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor project is planned to link them by rail.
